text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My head hurts for some reason... I wonder 
if this is what they call a migraine...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What should I do about today's stream...? 
If I cancel suddenly, everyone will worry.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, maybe I could spin this 
around and stream under the title 
'Migraine Stream'... Giving viewers a 
live, immersive look at a migraine—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that'll only make them worry 
more, huh? ......*sigh*... Ow ow ow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You continued to be 
plagued by headaches afterward.
